output.answer_markdown: The 8-K dated August 30, 2023 states that the exchange offer gave Johnson & Johnson a gain of approximately $20 billion in the third quarter of 2023 [1]. A later annual filing reports the non-cash gain on the exchange offer as $21.0 billion, recorded in net earnings from discontinued operations [2].
